claim: PostgreSQL / psql bidirectional cross-architecture logical restore verified
scope: Clean quiesced PostgreSQL 15 database restored through target-native logical SQL using psql in both arm64->amd64 and amd64->arm64 directions.
promotionEffect: Adds verified bidirectional PostgreSQL/psql logical restore evidence, but does not raise the public no-dump Machinen PostgreSQL snapshot/restore claim.

proofs.proves: A clean quiesced PostgreSQL 15 psql workload restored successfully through target-native logical SQL in both arm64->amd64 and amd64->arm64 directions.
proofs.claimUse: narrow PostgreSQL/psql logical cross-arch proof only; not a no-dump Machinen product snapshot/restore claim
proofs.next: Implement and retain no-dump Machinen product PostgreSQL capture/restore artifacts before raising portable PostgreSQL support.
